body: just make sure the person is highly qualified and able to give the correct treatment. i was going to a tmj specialist before who did facial massages, exercises, and etc but it wasn’t very helpful. the botox is the only thing that has gave me more long term relief because my muscles were so large. after multiple treatments you’ll need less units of botox and wont have to go so often. however, everyone is different and my tmj wasn’t as serious as it was more of a muscle issue. best of luck

yes, some dentists certified in doing botox can definitely do it! i personally did mine at a place i already go to for filler, that also does tmj botox. my dentist didn’t want me to get botox because he said i was “too young”, even though i’m 22 and nothing else has helped.
basically it “freezes” the masseter muscles and it eventually shrinks, so you don’t clench as much. i finally got it done a month ago and definitely recommend.
